components.css: .ds-nav{display:flex;gap:25px;min-height:76px;font:500 14px/1.5 var(--sans,'IBM Plex Sans',sans-serif)}.ds-nav a{display:flex;align-items:center;position:relative;color:var(--muted,#60656c);text-decoration:none}.ds-nav a[aria-current=page]{color:var(--ink,#1a1a1a)}.ds-nav a[aria-current=page]:after{position:absolute;bottom:0;height:2px;content:'';background:var(--accent,#a54420);width:100%}.ds-nav a:hover{color:var(--ink,#1a1a1a)}.ds-nav a:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#a54420);outline-offset:3px}@media(max-width:800px){.ds-nav{min-height:49px;gap:15px;justify-content:space-between;font-size:13px}}@media(max-width:600px){.ds-nav{min-height:46px;gap:8px;font-size:12px}}

components.css: .ds-product{display:flex;flex-direction:column;min-width:0;overflow:hidden;background:var(--surface,#fbfcfd);border:1px solid var(--rule,#d3d7dc);border-radius:var(--radius,3px);color:var(--ink,#1a1a1a);font:400 15px/1.5 var(--sans,'IBM Plex Sans',sans-serif)}.ds-product-image{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;height:180px;background:#eff1f4;border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule,#d3d7dc)}.ds-image-empty{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:10px;color:var(--muted,#60656c);font-size:11px}.ds-image-empty svg{width:34px;height:34px;stroke:#969ca5;stroke-width:1.2;fill:none}.ds-product-body{padding:16px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;flex:1}.ds-product-source{font:400 11px/1.5 var(--mono,'IBM Plex Mono',monospace);letter-spacing:.025em;color:var(--muted,#60656c);margin-bottom:8px}.ds-product h2{font:500 15px/1.45 var(--sans,'IBM Plex Sans',sans-serif);margin:0 0 8px;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.ds-product h2 a{color:var(--ink,#1a1a1a)}.ds-product-category{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted,#60656c);margin:0 0 10px}.ds-product-score,.ds-product-reasons{font-size:12px;color:var(--secondary,#4a4a4a)}.ds-product footer{border-top:1px solid var(--rule,#d3d7dc);padding-top:11px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;font-size:11px;color:var(--muted,#60656c)}.ds-product a{color:var(--accent,#a54420);text-decoration:none}.ds-product a:hover{color:var(--accent,#a54420);text-decoration:underline}.ds-product a:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#a54420);outline-offset:3px}@media(max-width:600px){.ds-product{display:grid;grid-template-columns:112px minmax(0,1fr)}.ds-product-image{height:auto;min-height:180px;border-bottom:0;border-right:1px solid var(--rule,#d3d7dc)}.ds-product-body{padding:12px}.ds-product h2{font-size:14px}.ds-product footer{flex-wrap:wrap}}

narrative.overview: The working catalog is the visual reference: products lead, controls remain familiar, and observed evidence has a stable place beside each item. Architectural alignment and modest typography carry the ATM identity without consuming the task space. Neutral ground and near-white card surfaces support product images, readable titles and useful filters.

rules.name: No cream
rules.body: Cream, beige, parchment and warm-white surfaces are excluded.

rules.name: Visible evidence
rules.body: Coverage text names the recent source scopes and distinguishes mixed historical runs from one selected live-search run.

rules.name: Keyboard and motion
rules.body: Keyboard users have a skip-to-content link, native form controls and a two-pixel focus outline with a three-pixel offset. Reduced-motion preferences disable transitions, skeleton animation and smooth scrolling.

dos: Do keep timestamps, scopes and partial-result states near their observations.
Do preserve neutral surfaces, local font delivery, visible keyboard focus and text-based state explanations.
Do let real product titles wrap and design the narrow layout structurally.
donts: Don't substitute charts, marketing headlines or decorative metrics for discovery content.
Don't use bold DM Serif Display, rounded pill containers or cream backgrounds.
Don't use color alone for status, return stored secrets into forms, or call history results live inventory.
